retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a romantic couple overlaid with vibrant pink 80s-style brush script and clean white supporting sans-serif text.
triggerTerms: pink neon script on monochrome photo
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a close-up, high-contrast monochrome photograph of a man and woman in an intimate dance embrace. The man is shirtless, showing his back to the viewer, while the woman faces him in a white blouse. A large, stylized pink brush-script title is centered over their torsos, with secondary white typography aligned at the bottom against a dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome background vs. vibrant pink focal text
Intimate physical proximity vs. bold graphic overlay
Soft theatrical lighting vs. sharp typographic edges
Dark lower third vs. bright upper subject highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The couple occupies the central 70% of the frame, cropped from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pink script title acts as the primary visual anchor, positioned at the center of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright faces of the couple, move down to the pink title, and finish at the white informational text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounds the couple, particularly at the top and bottom corners, focusing attention on the embrace.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white (grayscale) for the photographic subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the secondary and tertiary typography at the bottom.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Magenta/Pink for the main title script.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo (deep blacks to bright whites) paired with high saturation in the pink accent.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a 45-degree italic slant
Brush strokes have visible texture and varying thickness
Secondary text is all-caps with wide tracking
Tertiary text is bold sans-serif with tight tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'D' characters have elongated, sweeping tails
Letters are connected with fluid, handwritten ligatures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, expressive script paired with rigid, functional geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Underline stroke integrated into the script tail

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric contrast for the footer

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man and woman in a romantic dance embrace, theatrical lighting from above, dark background, square format.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large magenta brush-script title across the center. Add two lines of white all-caps sans-serif text at the bottom, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the main title a vibrant pink/magenta?
Is the footer text white and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Vertical position of the text block
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific 'Dirty Dancing' logo or wording
Do not replicate the specific actors' faces
Ensure the script is a unique vector path

mustAchieve: Clear separation between text and photo
Legible script despite the brush texture

postGenerationChecks: Confirm centered alignment of all elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Stage Photo + Magenta Brush Script + White Geometric Footer = Retro Cast Album Aesthetic
